## Overview

This [[adyen]] **PayNow for Android** page is an integration chooser. It links a PayNow **Android Drop-in** child guide and an **Android Components** child guide naming `InstantPaymentComponent`, then links main Android Sessions and Advanced guides for each UI path. Its brief Components label says “handle the redirect to PayNow”; that label is not an `action.type` contract. This chooser itself supplies no QR payload, app-switch procedure, version requirement, test-money warning, merchant setup or payment outcome. [[adyen-online-payments]]

## Key takeaways

- **Method-specific children:** Drop-in is described as an all-in-one UI solution; the Components route names `InstantPaymentComponent` and describes a redirect to PayNow. The chooser does not specify an API action type; consult the linked child guide for action handling. See raw lines 19–27.
- **Main integration first:** The See also section says to create the main integration before adding PayNow and links Android Drop-in/Components under both Sessions and Advanced. Their requirements, banking-app testing implications and final-status behavior are not on this page. See pinned raw lines 29–36.

## Detail locators

- PayNow Android Drop-in and Components child links: raw lines 19–27.
- Main Android Sessions/Advanced routes: raw lines 29–36.
